Functional spec/files: pin compatible shared Jido.Chat/WhatsApp package versions once authorized; remove transitional callback mode only after consumers migrate. Verify saved account restart, new pairing, logout/clear, failed save retry, saved/runtime_pending, Mnesia loss, multi-account recovery, and old stored credentials without migration. Explicit rollback and deployment order: shared contract, WhatsApp compatibility, host consumer, old callback removal later.
Tests before implementation/finalization: package contract suites, real ZAQ listener-to-Engine storage regressions, unchanged BO pairing/restart/full-flow tests, fault injection for concurrent sends/storage/state calls, timeouts and stale generations. No duplicate writes or lost authorization during compatibility. Reuse existing E2E; if new UX introduced, create approval/E2E issues before authoring. Run issue-level quality/focused tests and owner final gates; post-review coverage handoff per workflow.
Action reuse: no new executable operation; validate shared existing operations across repositories. Mocking only WhatsApp network; real host persistence. Docs: package contracts, existing service ownership sections, release/rollback notes in issue/PR. Commits/pushes/releases remain separately authorized. Do not claim application gate green after timeout or unrelated failure.
